original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州警方解救被绑架天主教神父等八人，逮捕两名嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州警察局在奥希米尼地方政府区开展协同救援行动，成功解救包括天主教神父约翰·奥塔切在内的八名被绑架者，并逮捕两名嫌疑人。据警方发言人声明，神父与另外七名受害者上周二在从村庄市场返回途中遭绑架。目前该事件为单一来源报道。

location.site: 奥希米尼地方政府区乌格博科洛—阿杰格贝—阿乌梅公路伊皮加村前路段
location.raw_text: Ohimini Local Government Area, Benue State; Ugbokolo–Ajegbe–Awume Road, before Ipiga Village

key_facts.fact: 贝努埃州警方解救八名被绑架者，包括天主教神父约翰·奥塔切
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Benue State Police Command has rescued eight kidnap victims, including a Catholic priest, Rev. Fr. John Otache of the Otukpo Diocese

key_facts.fact: 警方逮捕两名与绑架案相关的嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: arrested two suspects in connection with the abduction

key_facts.fact: 神父与另外七名受害者在从村庄市场返回途中遭绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the priest and seven other victims were kidnapped last Tuesday while returning from a village market along the Ugbokolo–Ajegbe–Awume Road

key_facts.fact: 警方联合机动警察部队和贝努埃州民防警卫开展协同救援行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: police operatives, working with personnel of the Police Mobile Force and the Benue State Civil Protection Guards, launched a coordinated rescue operation

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
嫌疑人身份及后续指控情况尚未公布
被绑架者当前状况未详细说明
